Battle for Dream Island is an animated web series created by twin brothers Cary and Michael Huang on January 1, 2010. The first season, Battle for Dream Island, follows 20 anthropomorphic objects (later 21). A second season, Battle for Dream Island Again, follows 11 returning contestants with 10 new ones. A fourth season, Battle for B.F.D.I., follows 64 contestants. During BFB, the season splits into Battle for B.F.B. and The Power of Two, with only 14 contestants remaining for BFB's continuation. The fifth season, The Power of Two, follows the 40 contestants from Battle for B.F.B. with the addition of two newcomers to join the season, making the total number of contestants 42. The sixth season, Battle for Dream Island Elsewhere, follows one returning contestant alongside 11 newcomers.

Characters
Hosts
* Announcer is the host of the first and sixth of Battle for Dream Island, who secretly hosted the first five episodes of Battle for Dream Island Again before making his return as the final antagonist in Battle for B.F.B. He is a gray rectangular speaker box from outer space, who offered the contestants Dream Island in the first season and frequently gets concerned over budget cuts, which often effects on how he runs the show.
Algebraliens
These creatures are extraterrestrial beings shaped like mathematical symbols (usually numbers) that originate from a place called the “Equation Playground”. They are major characters in Season 4 and 5 of BFDI and jacknjellify’s subscriber milestone videos. Algebraliens tend to have reality-warping powers, though not all of them are shown to have said powers.
* Zero (voiced by Xander Archibald) is a gray Algebralien representing the number zero.
* One (voiced by Emily Pitcher) is a blue Algebralien representing the number one. The first canonical appearance of One shows her as a lonely, self-conscious person who constantly seeks to interact with others but is dismissed or ignored. One's own mental health is shown to be deteriorating from the lack of communication with anyone, which causes her to become more aggressive around people. When she is locked inside the Moon, she turns more psychologically unstable and starts a revenge plot against the Algebraliens to repair Three.
* Two (voiced by Niall Burns) is a green Algebralien representing the number two. They were the host of Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two up until "Seasonal Shift".
* Three (voiced by Em Mintz-Kreyns) is a red Algebralien representing the number three. They often act kind and social and want to include everyone the majority of the time. They are shattered and killed by One in TPOT 20, and are revived in an unstable state.
* Four (voiced by Michael Huang) is the host of the fourth season of Battle for Dream Island: Battle for B.F.D.I. They are a blue Algebralien representing the number four. They are chaotic and mischievous, often torturing contestants for fun and, when provoked in the first half of BFB, also not tolerating criticism. In the second half, he becomes more calm, friendly and humble. They are shown to have god-like powers with which he can warp reality and teleport and eliminate contestants by sending them to a classroom called the "E.X.I.T.", which itself is in a pocket dimension he made in his body called the "Fourest". He also frequently screeches at contestants and shoots beams at them when provoked.
* Five (voiced by Dane Trent) is a purple Algebralien representing the number five. They are Three’s best friend and are very irritable and a stickler for the rules.
* Six (voiced by Florence Chapell) is a light blue colored Algebralien representing the number six.
* Seven (voiced by Griffin Weber) is a dark gray colored Algebralien representing the number seven. They like to tell jokes and make them funny but they usually fall flat and no one will eventually like them.
* Eight (voiced by Sam Thornbury) is a gray colored Algebralien representing the number eight.
* Nine (voiced by Sam Thornbury) is a white colored Algebralien representing the number nine. They own glasses and a yellow and blue skateboard and usually act like they’re “cool”.
* Ten (voiced by Bryan Ndubisi) is an orange colored Algebralien representing the number ten. In “Thanks for 2,000,000 subscribers!”, their skin gets eaten up by a green seven (which was actually Fourteen in disguise).
* Fourteen (voiced by Ivan Maslov) is a dark green colored Algebralien representing the number fourteen. They are a cannibal who like to eat people’s skin. In “Thanks for 2,000,000 subscribers!”, they split into two dark green sevens, one of them eventually going to Ten’s house and eating their skin.
* Fifteen (voiced by Joseph Pak) is a dark red colored Algebralien representing the number fifteen. She is very strict and lives in a cabin in the forest and also has a crush on Zero.
* X (voiced by Cary Huang) is the co-host of the fourth season of Battle for Dream Island: Battle for B.F.D.I. They are a yellow Algebralien representing the variable X.
Contestants
The contestants are characters (often objects) that compete for a prize.
Debuted in Battle for Dream Island
* Blocky (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, and BFB. He is a wooden red block who likes to pull pranks on other characters. In each of the ''Blocky's Funny Doings International'' segments, he demonstrates how a contestant's recovery center can be booby-trapped so that they die repeatedly.
* Bubble (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, and BFB. She is a kindhearted and happy soap bubble that gets popped a lot. But in later seasons, she has become more anxious and sensitive.
* Coiny (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a nice but rude penny that has a rivalry with Firey, with whom he shares a mutual history of slapping each other. In later seasons, he becomes nicer and more thoughtful to people. He has a friendship with Pin and liked competing with her in BFDIA.
* David (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFB, and BFDIE. He is a mysterious poorly-drawn stick-figure who only says "Aw, Seriously?" being his catchphrase and only phrase he can say. He can also be quite antisocial, often refusing to follow directions of others. He is allergic to sunrises.
* Eraser (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a grumpy, bored and impatient pink eraser, who has a close friendship with Pen and Blocky. He likes having rivalries and often tries to form them with characters like Teardrop and Bottle.
* Firey (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, and BFB. He is a competitive, loyal and gullible flame, who has a rivalry with Coiny, having a history of slapping each other. He’s also the best friend of Leafy.
* Flower (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, and BFB. She is a Zeltnera venusta flowering plant. She started off in BFDI as a mean, nasty and short-tempered person who was extremely disliked by all of the other contestants, always wanting people to call her beautiful. In BFB, she becomes more friendly and upbeat.
* Golf Ball (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is an intelligent and bossy golf ball. She has a good friendship with Tennis Ball, and she always tries to assert herself as a leader.
* Ice Cube (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu in BFB 1 and 13-30; and by Pokey in BFB 2-12, TPOT, and BFDIA 6+) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is an outwardly kind ice cube always seeking revenge for people who disobey her.
* Leafy (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI and BFB. She is a kind-hearted, generous, impulsive, green leaf who tries to be a people-pleaser.
* Match (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, and BFB. She has a close friendship with Pencil. She is friendly to specific contestants and will be mean and exclude most others, usually following and agreeing with whatever Pencil wants to do. She feels guilt for how she treated some others and becomes kinder in her limited screen-time throughout the show.
* Needle (voiced by Cary Huang in BFDI, BFDIA 1-5, and IDFB, Satomi Hinatsu in BFB 1, and Pokey in BFB 2+, TPOT, and BFDIA 6+) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is an assertive, resourceful and vengeful gray sewing needle. She will become angry and slap anyone who calls her "Needy".
* Pen (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a kind, loyal, empathetic and considerate white and blue ballpoint pen. He is good friends with contestants Blocky and Eraser, but he often shows to be the kindest out of the three.
* Pencil (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a wooden No. 2 pencil. She is caring to her friends and often sticks up for them if anyone is mean to them. She becomes a controlling and manipulative figure in BFB. In TPOT, she becomes more mentally unstable due to the events and trauma she faced in the E.X.I.T.
* Pin (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a confident and fierce red thumbtack who bosses people around in an attempt to become a “heroic team leader”. In later seasons, she displays more self-righteousness and integrity.
* Rocky (voiced by Cary Huang in BFDI and Satomi Hinatsu in TPOT) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a bizarre and erratic rock who can barely speak and only produces and throws up vomit.
* Snowball (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a competitive, jock-like, egoistical snowball who tries to act tough around people and regards anyone he does not like as weaklings.
* Spongy (voiced by Cary Huang and briefly Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, and BFB. He is a gentle and sensitive fat yellow kitchen sponge who is not well-received among many contestants, with most of them considering him dead-weight for challenges due to his weight.
* Teardrop is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a mischievous, rebellious and deadly blue teardrop. She is mute, meaning she cannot speak.
* Tennis Ball (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, BFB, and BFDI:TPOT. He is a clumsy and intelligent tennis ball who is very close friends with Golf Ball, and is even implied to have a crush on her. He is good at inventing and robotics.
* Woody (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDI, BFDIA, and BFB. He is a piece of balsa wood who often gets nervous over things. He has panophobia.
Debuted in Battle for Dream Island Again
* Bomby (voiced by Michael Huang in BFDI, BFDIA 1-5, and IDFB; and by Satomi Hinatsu in BFB, TPOT, and BFDIA 6+) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a jumpy and easily scared bomb who explodes often when his fuse is lit. He constantly snacks on bananas.
* Book (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a determined, loyal and gullible green and blue hardcover book. She has a hard time controlling herself when angered, as shown in BFB, in which she marked another contestant, Taco, as a traitor.
* Donut (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a considerate, thoughtful and arrogant jelly-filled donut who displays his rational side when he shows care for his teammates and acts as a team leader. He hosted BFB episodes 6 through 9.
* Dora is a contestant in BFDIA, and BFB. She is a calm, collected and mysterious stick figure. She is obsessed with eating islands, which is all she talks about. Like David, she also speaks a few words being "Dadadada". She is implied to be a parody of Dora the Explorer.
* Fries (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a grumpy, sarcastic and antipathetic cardboard cup of French fries. Fries believes that people who take the mantle of leadership are valuable.
* Gelatin (voiced by Graham Taylor in BFDIA 1-5 and BFB 1-23; Ian Woodside in BFB 24-30, TPOT 1–19; and BFDIA 6–22; and Alem Hadzic in TPOT 20+ and BFDIA 23+) is a contestant in BFDIA, and BFB. He is a laid-back, childish and immature block of carved lime-flavored gelatin, who runs a steakhouse called Gelatin's Steakhouse.
* Nickel (voiced by Adam Katz) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a goofy, happy-go-lucky American nickel who shouts random erratic and nonsensical phrases.
* Puffball (voiced by Michael Huang with a vocoder) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a calm, bubbly, fuzzy pink ball who has a vocoded voice and fur that changes color when she talks. She has the ability to fly and float, and she is usually calm except when she is wronged.
* Ruby (voiced by Michael Huang in BFDI, BFDIA 1-5, and IDFB; and Cary Huang in BFB, TPOT and BFDIA 6+) is a contestant in BFDIA, and BFB. She is a bubbly, silly and curious diamond-cut ruby. She enjoys playing around with other contestants and is shown to look up to contestants with leadership roles, such as Pencil.
* Yellow Face (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDIA, BFB, and BFDI:TPOT. He is a loud and erratic poorly-drawn yellow cartoon head that appears in mock commercial segments where he sells outlandish products. He is shown to largely hate contestants that oppose his ads or products. He runs a company called Yellow Face Inc.
Debuted in Battle for B.F.D.I/Battle for B.F.B.
* 8-Ball (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFB. He is a black "8" billiard ball from the same-named pool game who always wants everyone to know that he does not have a favorite number.
* Balloony (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB. He is a green rubber balloon.
* Barf Bag (voiced by Pokey) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a sickness bag half full with vomit. Her strength varies depending on how full and the type of liquid she contains.
* Basketball (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a basketball who has a passion for creating inventions and has a friendship with Robot Flower.
* Bell (voiced by Pokey) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a bell suspended from a long string, and dislikes when people climb it, which leads to Bandland.
* Black Hole (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a black hole who is immensely powerful, and is steadfast in his desire to not cause death.
* Bottle (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a glass bottle who acts carefree and sometimes oblivious to her surroundings.
* Bracelety (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFB. She is a cyan-colored silicone ring who is often shown obsessing over Ice Cube.
* Cake (voiced by Pokey) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a slice of chocolate cake with white and red icing on top. He acts shy and dependent on others, especially to Loser, who he is loyal to.
* Clock (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a blue and white clock. He often acts self-righteously and an enforcer of rules.
* Cloudy (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a cumulus cloud able to fly. He speaks with an accent in which voiced and unvoiced consonants are swapped. He likes to collect items and keep them to himself.
* Eggy (voiced by Katherine Sun) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a white egg with yellow spots.
* Fanny (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a blue fan who expresses her hatred for everything, though is quite reasonable and does what she believes is right. In early BFB, She is apathetic and eccentric.
* Firey Jr. (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB. He is a small version of Firey. Unlike Firey, he acts more insensitive and bluntly.
* Foldy (voiced by Cindy Jiang) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a folded sheet of origami paper shaped like a pentagon. She tends to act friendly to others, but she is enemies with Liy and can act aggressive towards people who go against her or Stapy.
* Gaty (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a painted wooden fence gate with metal hinges. She often acts as the voice of reason, criticizing the actions of others. She later develops a friendship with Two. She is confirmed to be transgender.
* Grassy (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a green tuft of grass. He acts the most childish of the cast, and relies on others for help. He later on learns to become stronger and independent.
* Lightning (voiced by Sabrina) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a lightning bolt able to electrocute anyone he touches.
* Liy (voiced by Sabrina) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a periwinkle light switch who claims to have had a murderous past. If her switch is flipped, she can go on a killing spree.
* Lollipop (voiced by Sam Lee) is a contestant in BFB. She a grape-flavored lollipop who acts snide and above others. She tries to sell an aerosol spray can able to deflect forks. She often acts as a competitor to Yellow Face in marketing.
* Loser (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFB. He is a yellow cube popular among the contestants due to having a celebrity status. He loses his popularity in BFB 7, after claiming he “used to play with” toys that had been invented hours prior.
* Marker (voiced by Cary Huang) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a purple washable marker pen with a chisel tip. He likes playing a game about tossing dirt over his head.
* Naily (voiced by Katherine Sun) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a metal nail (fastener) who commonly makes puns about 'nailing it'.
* Pie (voiced by Sam Lee) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a blueberry pie in a pie tin. She has the ability to explode when experiencing physical trauma. Despite this, she acts apathetic and relaxed.
* Pillow (voiced by Cindy Jiang) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a psychopathic pillow who wants to research killing people. She often does things without caring and kills people whenever she can.
* Profily (voiced by Niall Burns) is a blue-colored default profile picture who first appears in BFB. They claim to have been competing since BFDI 1, much to the contestants' (and Four's) chagrin. They also make minor appearances in BFDI:TPOT, dropping Teardrop off to the competition site so she can join, and offering Balloony the same.
* Remote is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a black plastic remote control. She talks with a speech synthesis voice, and is able to use her buttons to control TV.
* Robot Flower (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a robot copy of Flower, and shares similar behaviors as her. However, Robot Flower is able to be reprogrammed, and experience glitches.
* Roboty is a contestant in BFB. He is an immobile red-colored robot who speaks in morse code. He is often dismissive of most contestants, and is usually left behind due to his lack of movement ability.
* Saw (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. She is a metal ripsaw with a pink wooden handle. In BFB 8, she gets an illness causing her to involuntarily say the number eight while speaking.
* Stapy (voiced by Sam Lee) is a contestant in BFB. He is a red office stapler who doesn’t have legs. He hops around and uses his body to crush and staple things. He calls these actions his “stapler instincts.”
* Taco (voiced by Pokey) is a contestant in BFB. She is a soft shell fish taco. She is incorrectly accused of abandoning her team after being stuck in a large, hollow gobstopper.
* Tree (voiced by Thomas Chick) is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a tree who often acts like the leader of his team or as the voice of reason. He has the ability to be resurrected and grow into a larger tree when in contact in water. Other contestants are also able to control his body when inside his leaves and branches.
* TV is a contestant in BFB and BFDI:TPOT. He is a flatscreen plasma television able to display videos and infographics on his screen.
Debuted in Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two
* Price Tag (voiced by B. Oktavio Wolfmann) is a contestant in BFDI:TPOT. They are a red price tag who uses emoticons for a face.
* Winner (voiced by Schazer) is a contestant in BFDI:TPOT. They are a purple blob with one retractable hand that can come out of their body. They were a former celebrity along with Loser. The two parted ways when Loser became more popular.
Debuted in Battle for Dream Island Elsewhere
* Beach Ball (voiced by Joseph Pak) is a contestant in BFDIE. They are an inflated beach ball.
* Fern (voiced by Pokey) is a contestant in BFDIE. He is a fern.
* Hot Dog (voiced by Peter Ruette) is a contestant in BFDIE. He is a hot dog topped with  mustard and chopped onions.
* Jammy (voiced by Katherine Sun) is a contestant in BFDIE. She is a jar of peach jam.
* Money (voiced by Michael Huang) is a contestant in BFDIE. She is a bundle of folded  dollars held within a money clip.
* Needy (voiced by Bella Reeves) is a contestant in BFDIE. She is a syringe containing a purple fluid.
* Rose (voiced by Gooseworx) is a contestant in BFDIE. She is a red rose.
* Ruler (voiced by Thomas Ridgewell) is a contestant in BFDIE. He is a wooden ruler.
* Sidewalky (voiced by Adam Katz) is a contestant in BFDIE. He is a segment of a concrete sidewalk.
* Sticker (voiced by Xander Archibald) is a contestant in BFDIE. They are a square adhesive sticker.
* Toothpaste (voiced by Satomi Hinatsu) is a contestant in BFDIE. She is a white tube of toothpaste.
Other recurring characters
* Evil Leafy is a red, demonic, and hostile version of Leafy. When contestants are near, she teleports to chase after them. If she gets the contestants, she eats them alive.
* Nonexisty doesn't exist, as his name would imply. He was up for debut in BFDI, where he didn't get enough votes to join, and BFDI:TPOT, where he got the second-most votes to join, almost making it in but being replaced by Price Tag due to his aforementioned nonexistence.
* Pan Flute (voiced by Kevin MacLeod) is a pan flute, a successful musician who leads a orchestra whose instruments get poisoned in BFDIA 12.
* Purple Face (voiced by Justin Chapman and later Benjamin Cross) is a poorly-drawn purple face. He has an immense hatred towards Yellow Face.
